top: ...as rivers of water in a dry place,
bottom: as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

top: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return,
bottom: and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy...

top: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
bottom: they shall mount up with wings as eagles...

top: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee,
bottom: I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

top: And even to your old age I am he;
bottom: and even to hoar hairs will I carry you...

top: But he was wounded for our transgressions,
bottom: ...and with his stripes we are healed.

top: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet
bottom: of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace...
